reviews.title: Great for the price.
reviews.comment:
The Razer Basilisk V3 is hands down one of the best gaming mice I've ever used. It's super comfy even during long gaming sessions thanks to its ergonomic design, and the customizable buttons are perfect for both gaming and getting stuff done. The RGB lighting looks awesome, and the HyperScroll wheel is surprisingly handy for switching between precise and fast scrolling.
The sensor is super accurate and responsive, and the mouse just glides across my mousepad. I also love how easy it is to customize everything through Razer Synapse. Whether I'm playing FPS games, MMOs, or just browsing, this mouse works perfectly.
If you want a top-notch gaming mouse with tons of customization and excellent comfort, the Basilisk V3 is totally worth it. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Louis Barber

reviews.title: Great mouse for price
reviews.comment:
I bought this because I just needed a new mouse, and it ended up being way better than I expected for the price. I’ve been using it on my computer for regular stuff and gaming, and it’s been really solid so far. I’ve had it for over a year and it’s working great. 
The RGB lighting is honestly one of my favorite parts. I messed around with it and made my own color setup, and the software was actually pretty easy to figure out, which surprised me. Hypershift works really well. There’s also this “turbo” feature in the software that basically acts like an auto clicker, and it can go up to 20 cps.
I haven’t had any issues with it so far. Only thing to know is the software doesn’t really work on Macs, so that could be a problem depending on what you use.
Overall, I’d say it’s a great mouse, especially for gaming. Feels good, looks cool, and has a lot more features than I was expecting.
reviews.author: DE

reviews.title: honest review
reviews.comment: i have owned like 8 mouses from $20-$120. i got this for $35 and this is absolutely the best mouse i ever owned. the lighting, feel, shape, customization, etc is perfection for me. this mouse has 26k DPI, the mouse wheel is amazing and smooth to spin and has grip to it and the wheel can click side to side. it has grip on the sides and my hand never slips. to customizable buttons on the side and a big side button to instantly change mouse sensitivity. the app is a breeze to use which you can customize the color of the rgb lighting. no lie playing Apex with this mouse is 10x better than playing with my other mouse. i will will buy this model from now on
reviews.author: Jocelyn

reviews.title: This Mouse Ruined Cheap Mice for Me
reviews.comment:
I’ve genuinely liked using the Razer Basilisk V3. The first thing I noticed was how comfortable it felt. Some mice are fine for about 20 minutes and then they start feeling like a weirdly shaped brick. This mouse has been much better for longer use, whether I’m gaming or just clicking around online doing whatever nonsense I got distracted by.
What I like most is that it feels like someone actually thought about how a hand works. The buttons are responsive, the movement is smooth, and the scroll wheel feels so nice that it almost made reading comment sections worth it. Almost. While this mouse has not been life changing in a dramatic movie soundtrack kind of way, it has changed my expectations enough that going back to a cheaper mouse would feel like using a shopping cart with one bad wheel.
Oh, and the customization. I am not out here trying to launch a space mission from my desk, but it is nice being able to set things up in a way that actually fits how I use it. Once everything is dialed in, it just feels easy.
Overall, it has been a genuinely solid mouse and one of those upgrades you stop thinking about because it just quietly does its job well. Which, for a mouse, is honestly the dream. It just sits there, minds its business, and makes me slightly more powerful than I probably deserve.
reviews.author: BearFire

reviews.title: Solid Gaming Mouse for Speed and Comfort – A Solid Choice for Gamers!
reviews.comment:
I purchased the Razer Basilisk V3 for my son after he specifically asked for it, and so far, he’s been pleased with it. As a parent, I was initially a little hesitant due to the price, but after seeing how well it performs, I think it was a solid investment.
One of the main features my son really appreciates is the customizable options that the Basilisk V3 offers. From programmable buttons to adjustable sensitivity settings, he can really fine-tune the mouse to fit his personal preferences and gaming style. He uses it for everything from casual gaming sessions to more intense, competitive play, and it handles everything smoothly. The ergonomic design is another major plus. The shape and weight feel great in his hand, and he says it’s comfortable to use for extended periods—important for those marathon gaming sessions.
The speed and accuracy of this mouse are really impressive. The optical sensor provides pixel-perfect precision, and the fastest gaming mouse switch delivers great feedback and response time, something that’s crucial for high-speed gaming. While he’s not a professional gamer, my son definitely noticed the difference in performance compared to his previous, more basic mouse.
The RGB lighting is a fun touch, too. The Chroma RGB lighting system allows him to personalize the mouse with a variety of colors and lighting effects, which adds a cool flair to his gaming setup. It's also fun to change up the lights depending on his mood or the game he’s playing.
The only reason I gave it four stars instead of five is that, while it's an excellent mouse, it might be a little on the larger side for kids with smaller hands. My son has no trouble with it, but younger children or those with smaller hands might find it less comfortable.
Overall, if you’re looking for a high-performance gaming mouse with lots of customization options and a comfortable ergonomic design, the Razer Basilisk V3 is a great choice. It offers precision, speed, and the customizability needed for serious gaming, all while looking stylish with its RGB lighting. My son is happy with it, and I can see why—it’s a top-tier mouse at a reasonable price point for what you get!
reviews.author: Jonathan Lee
